description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search the Space Regulatory & Spectrum License Ledger across FCC space and spectrum filings (47 CFR Part 25), FAA commercial space launch and reentry licensing (14 CFR Part 450 and Parts 400-460) and NOAA commercial remote sensing licensing (15 CFR Part 960). Every row carries an official US government sourceUrl and deterministic non-fuzzy company attribution. Filter by regulator, regime, company slug, docket, CFR reference, spectrum band, search text, date range and matched-only.

cfr_part.description: CFR citation substring, e.g. "47 CFR Part 25", "Part 450", "Part 960".

docket.description: Docket, ICFS file number or Federal Register document number substring.

limit.description: How many regulatory filings to return (1 to 25).

matched_only.description: Only return rows attributed to a tracked SpaceNexus company.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

query.description: Search words in title, filer, docket, CFR reference or bureau.

regime.description: Regulatory regime: fcc-icfs-spectrum, faa-part-450-launch or noaa-remote-sensing.

regulator.description: Issuing US federal authority: FCC, FAA or NOAA.

since.description: Filings dated on or after this UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD).

spectrum_band.description: RF spectrum band or orbital tag, e.g. "Ka-band", "Ku-band", "S-band", "NGSO", "Direct-to-Device (SCS)".

until.description: Filings dated before this UTC day, exclusive (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: research_regulatory_ledger
title: Space regulatory & spectrum ledger
